_comment: Sentire Ledger tutorial videos, V01 to V38. Seeded into PH Tutorial Video on install and migrate. The files live in the private video bucket under tutorials/<code>/ (video.mp4, captions.vtt, poster.jpg); upload them from the Tutorial Videos list. steps: the onboarding steps whose card plays the video. help_for: the forms that offer it under the Help button.

videos.title: Set up your Philippine company
videos.summary: COR details on the Company, then one click adds the PH accounts, account mapping and BIR Series

videos.title: Your tax rules, dated and confirmed
videos.summary: Every rate is a dated rule; drafts until your accountant confirms; how rules fill invoices and bills

videos.title: Your first BIR invoice
videos.summary: Serial from the BIR Series on submit, BIR header, original and duplicate, corrections by credit or debit note

videos.title: Compute and file a BIR return
videos.summary: BIR Returns: figures from the books, what still needs you, DRAFT preview, eBIRForms export, filing with the confirmation

videos.title: Export the books
videos.summary: The seven books with BIR header and tie-outs; the year-end pack

videos.title: Build the registration pack
videos.summary: Provider and signatory details, then one download for the RDO

videos.title: Your chart of accounts
videos.summary: The PH accounts the setup adds (Output VAT, Input VAT by kind, EWT payable, CWT receivable) and the account mapping

videos.title: Trace every posting
videos.summary: General Ledger, the BIR Audit Trail and the event log nobody can rewrite

videos.title: Add a customer
videos.summary: TIN, registered name, address, top withholding agent and what it changes

videos.title: Add a supplier
videos.summary: TIN, payee type, VAT status and withholding category, the basis of every 2307

videos.title: Add an item
videos.summary: VAT class (VATable, zero-rated, exempt), capital goods, stocked or not

videos.title: Get paid
videos.summary: Payment Entry against the invoice, tax withheld by the customer, the 2307 you receive

videos.title: Enter a supplier's bill
videos.summary: Purchase Invoice: Input VAT and EWT worked out from the supplier profile

videos.title: Pay your supplier and issue the 2307
videos.summary: Payment net of EWT, the 2307 per quarter, where the 0619-E and 1601-EQ figures come from

videos.title: Post a journal entry
videos.summary: Accruals and corrections; the posting-date lock and who may back-date

videos.title: Check your profit
videos.summary: P&L for any period and the book-to-tax reconciliation behind the income tax returns

videos.title: Know what you own and owe
videos.summary: Balance Sheet on any date

videos.title: Confirm a sales order
videos.summary: Order to delivery to invoice from one document

videos.title: Record a supplier's quote
videos.summary: Compare suppliers before ordering

videos.title: Place a purchase order
videos.summary: Order, receive and bill from one document; approval above an amount

videos.title: Track your orders
videos.summary: What was ordered, received and billed

videos.title: Your warehouses
videos.summary: Where stock is kept; one per branch or store

videos.title: Enter the stock you have today
videos.summary: Opening quantities and values in one Stock Reconciliation

videos.title: Receive goods
videos.summary: Stock goes up; the bill comes from the receipt

videos.title: Ship to a customer
videos.summary: Stock goes down; the invoice comes from the delivery

videos.title: Move stock
videos.summary: Transfers between store, shop floor and branches

videos.title: Check your stock levels
videos.summary: Stock Balance and the Inventory Book

videos.title: Plan a work order
videos.summary: How many to make; materials from the BOM

videos.title: Break a project into tasks
videos.summary: Who does what, by when

videos.title: Log time
videos.summary: Timesheets for billing or costing

videos.title: Track progress and costs
videos.summary: Project Summary report

videos.title: Plan maintenance visits
videos.summary: Service visits scheduled for the whole contract

videos.title: Correct a filed return
videos.summary: Filed returns are read-only; Request change, the manager approves, the amendment opens

videos.title: Approval chains
videos.summary: Steps, recipients, order, conditions; Request approval, Approve, Reject; the home card

videos.title: File your withholding tax returns
videos.summary: 0619-E monthly, 1601-EQ quarterly with its QAP, on the BIR's own forms

videos.title: File your income tax return
videos.summary: 1702Q and 1702-RT from the books, on the BIR's own forms

videos.title: Prepare your SLSP and BIR data files
videos.summary: SLSP per month, QAP and SAWT files, kept under Alphalist Files

videos.title: File your percentage tax return
videos.summary: 2551Q for a non-VAT taxpayer, on the BIR's own form
